title: Mobile: navigation and patterns
question: Which mobile navigation should we use?

variants.label: Dock + More
variants.notes: Bottom dock with Home, Terminal, Files, Services and More. More opens a sheet with every section, plugin pages, Settings and the host switcher. Each shows 4 phones: Services list, details as a bottom sheet, the navigation, and the terminal with a row of extra keys (Ctrl, Esc, Tab, arrows).

variants.label: Dock + search button
variants.notes: Dock with a big centre button that opens search: type a service, file or section and jump there. “All” lists every section. Each shows 4 phones: Services list, details as a bottom sheet, the navigation, and the terminal with a row of extra keys (Ctrl, Esc, Tab, arrows).

variants.label: Menu launcher
variants.notes: No dock: a menu button opens a launcher of colourful section tiles with a live summary each (1 failed, 23 updates…). Each shows 4 phones: Services list, details as a bottom sheet, the navigation, and the terminal with a row of extra keys (Ctrl, Esc, Tab, arrows).
